title: Critical CVE blocking deployment pipeline
symptoms: CI/CD pipeline fails at image scan stage
Wiz/Prisma/Trivy reports critical CVE in base image or dependency
ArgoCD sync blocked by OPA/Gatekeeper policy
Production running vulnerable image while fix is in progress
root_cause: Outdated base image; transitive dependency CVE; no patch available yet; exception process not followed
workaround: Assess exploitability; if not exploitable in context, request time-limited exception with compensating controls; upgrade base image or dependency
permanent_fix: Weekly base image rebuilds; Dependabot/Renovate for dependency updates; defined CVE SLA (Critical 7d, High 30d); exception registry with expiry

auto_healing.mechanism: Automated base image rebuild on CVE publish; auto-PR from Renovate for patchable deps

notes: Maintain CVE exception registry with owner, expiry, and compensating controls
